title: Communal street 1.2 m universally accessible pedestrian path (20 or more potential lots)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: New to the grouped package (no Chapter 2 twin). Applies where the communal street serves 20 or more potential strata or survey-strata lots (site.communal_street_serves_lots, read as potential lots or dwellings each taking driveway access from the communal street). Greenfield in practice. parking.pedestrian_access_width_m is read as the width of the pedestrian path within the communal street (the same fact C3.7.11(i) tests at 1 m). 'Universally accessible' is not tested.
text: Notwithstanding C3.7.13, where a proposed development has the potential to be subdivided to create 20 or more strata lots or survey-strata lots, with each lot obtaining driveway access from a communal street, the communal street shall be a minimum 12m wide, which shall include: ii. a 1.2m wide universally accessible pedestrian path;

verified.note: 1.2m and the 20-lot trigger confirmed. 'Universally accessible' is not tested; the width fact is the same one C3.7.11(i) tests at 1m.
